units: BVSE valence^2 (empirical softBV) — NOT eV; relative/geometric pre-screen, calibrate vs DFT-NEB or same-method comp1/modelc for absolute scale
interpretation: In-plane (a,b) Li network is open at the lowest resolvable threshold (<=0.50 val^2, 6.7% channel volume). Through the long c stacking axis, which contains the B2O3 dopant layers (B z~0.36/0.46, O z~0.24/0.81), percolation needs ~1.99 val^2 (~4x higher) = the dopant layers are the c-axis bottleneck.
